title: Convolution + Transformer in 2D

items.name: Local features
items.note: 32 channels. Periodic padding on both axes in these tests.

items.name: Global attention
items.note: One encoder block; width32, FF64, ReLU, dropout0. No positional embeddings.

items.name: Scalar head
items.note: Physical order i=yLx+x. Dense head can break translation symmetry.

footer: 2D generalization of the existing 1D ConvTransformer: Conv1d becomes a boundary-aware Conv2d, followed by the same attention/flatten/dense pattern. Dropout is set to0 for deterministic VMC. Local convolution and global attention provide complementary features; improved accuracy is an empirical question, not guaranteed by this structure.
